versions.content: If the parameter TcpIpArpPacketQueueEnabled is set to FALSE and an IPv4 packet shall be transmitted to a remote host but the related link layer address does not exist in the ARP table, the TcpIp shall start the address resolution but reject the transmission request with E_NOT_OK.

If the parameter TcpIpArpPacketQueueEnabled is set to FALS E and an IPv4 packet shall be transmitted to a remote host but the related link layer address does not exist in the ARP table, the TcpIp shall start the address resolution but reject the transmission request with E_NOT_OK.
